description: Abstract base class for entity ID placeholders within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides utility methods for supported placeholder names and resolving parts of an entity ID, such as namespace, name, and ID.

classes.name: AbstractEntityPlaceholder
classes.description: An abstract class implementing EntityPlaceholder that provides common functionality for handling entity ID placeholders.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns the list of supported placeholder names: 'id', 'namespace', and 'name'.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given name is supported as a placeholder.

methods.name: doResolve
methods.description: Resolves the placeholder value from the given entity ID, returning an Optional String.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object.
